notes:
Both titles verified against DOI metadata. No full primary paper obtained; abstract-only records were not used to establish analytic n, test statistics, p values, target match, or narrative verdict. Original acquisition: DOI landing page HTTP 403; Unpaywall no OA locations; OpenAlex no best OA location, historical CiteSeerX record found; Europe PMC no full text; CiteSeerX PDF HTTP 404; targeted open-web search yielded no accessible full primary source. Replication acquisition: DOI redirected to Elsevier; publisher full-article route HTTP 403; Unpaywall no OA locations; OpenAlex no best OA location; Europe PMC no full text; targeted open-web search yielded abstract/metadata records only. No conversions or secondary-source statistic substitutions.
Source follow-up: Unassigned side not examined. Printed main effect F4.76,p.032 and n119 verified on rendered primary PDF2–3. This is an increase in pain, qualified by Stimulus Type×SOA interaction F(2,95)=6.25,p=.004. Target mismatch is modality/timing, not an unavailable paper; do not treat main-effect significance as replication success.
Source follow-up: Published article copy from private Google Drive archive; DOI is not printed in the artifact front matter. Independent Crossref record matches exact requested title and author surname(s), year/issue and page range 275-281. PDF has7pages, complete main paper with methods/results and end references; model-reviewed first-page and final-substantive-page excerpts. First-page authors=Blumenthal,Burnett,Swerdlow; title coverage=1.0. No shipped audit-value comparison. Rendered p. 277 confirms F=3.10 and printed df=4,19 (retained verbatim). Post-hoc 60 ms/1.0T comparison also printed F=18.45, p<.0005; broad locator does not specify that contrast.
